text:
maria: quick ask — I need temporary admin elevation (30m) to investigate a redaction failure in prod logs. Repro steps show sensitive tokens not being masked for some request paths. Need access to project redwood-prod-logs and Kibana dashboards to pull traces. Will follow break-glass runbook and delete any snapshots after. https://redwood.internal/runbooks/log-redaction :lock:
kevin: can you scope it down to just the logging cluster and kibana? prefer role=logs-admin instead of full admin. also what time window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ashley: +1 on minimal scope. please attach the exact resource names and justification so I can approve. :thumbsup:
sam: FYI if you touch any export pipelines ping me — I own the log-export infra. also confirm you won't export data off-network.
maria: thanks — scope: project redwood-prod-logs, resources: kubernetes cluster gke-redwood-prod-2, kibana space redwood-prod, bigquery dataset logs_redacted (read-only). justification: triaging mis-redaction for user PII showing up in stack traces. start window target: 1738257000 (UTC), duration 30m. I'll run only read queries and follow runbook steps.
kevin: ok attach a short approval note here and I'll escalate in Okta. also paste the CLI you'll run so infra can audit.
maria: planned commands: ```
# list recent 1k logs with suspect path
gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND jsonPayload.path:/user/transfer" --project=redwood-prod-logs --limit=1000
# view kibana saved search
curl -u $ME https://kibana.redwood.internal/s/redwood-prod/api/saved_objects/_find?type=search
```
jyoti: quick reminder — do not include raw token values in screenshots or snippets. redact any examples before posting. also add a short note referencing the privacy checklist in PR template.
kevin: approved for role=roles/logs.admin on project redwood-prod-logs from 1738257000 to 1738258800. I'll create the Okta ticket and grant via timebound role. tagging @infra-bot to record.
infra-bot: [ACCESS_LOG] grant created: user=maria, role=roles/logs.admin, resource=redwood-prod-logs, start=1738257000, end=1738258800, ticket=OKTA-4521
maria: got it, thanks. I'll post results here and delete any artifacts per runbook. will also escalate if I need to extend. :white_check_mark:
ashley: please update the incident board row with a short summary after you're done so we have a trace for audits.
maria: will do. quick note — if I find an ingestion rule that's incorrectly dropping redaction flags I may need a follow-up change; will open a PR and link back to this thread.
sam: thanks — I'll be on standby in case the export pipelines need to be paused.
kevin: closing loop: documented in OKTA-4521, infra audit will pick up logs. react with :eyes: when you're live, maria.
maria: live now (1738257005). reproducing the bad event and collecting context.
infra-bot: [AUDIT] session started: session_id=ses-9a7c, actor=maria, start_ts=1738257005
maria: found the root cause: regex for masking omitted query param `token`. pushing a safe fix to the mask library PR -> will request review. collecting masked sample and will paste sanitized example here.
jyoti: great, remember to include a privacy sign-off on the PR if it affects regex for PII.
maria: sample posted (sanitized). ending session and deleting temp files per runbook.
infra-bot: [ACCESS_LOG] revoke scheduled: user=maria, role=roles/logs.admin, revoke_ts=1738258800
kevin: thanks everyone. good run. :tada:
